description: After an Azure deployment slot swap, every request to the pricing API fails. App Service diagnostics show the production slot cannot read its Key Vault reference because its managed identity has no secret permission. The same build runs in staging with a different identity.

A batch simulation cannot start any workers in its Azure region. The deployment operation reports a regional vCPU quota exceeded error before a virtual machine is created. Existing workers and the application submission page continue to operate.

An Azure Functions queue consumer stopped running after its hosting plan was changed. Invocation logs show the function host failing to mount its required Azure Files content share. Messages remain in the queue and no application handler is invoked.

A synthetic contractor account can authenticate to the directory but cannot see the newly assigned enterprise application. The sign-in log says user assignment required; the approved application access group is absent from the account's effective memberships. The application works for an existing authorized account on the same device.

A test account password reset succeeds, but sign-ins across several unrelated enterprise applications are rejected as account locked. Directory authentication logs show repeated attempts using an old password from a retired test device. Other accounts on the current laptop work.

All accounts using a newly federated test email suffix are rejected before any application session is created. Federation diagnostics show that the identity provider sends a NameID with an unrecognized suffix. Accounts with the established suffix can sign in from the same browsers.

Devices on a newly opened office wing receive self-assigned addresses instead of DHCP leases. A packet capture shows DHCP discovery broadcasts with no replies, and the distribution switch has no relay configured for that VLAN. Assigning an approved static test address restores access.

Several branches cannot reach a partner's public HTTPS endpoint after a WAN routing change. Traceroutes stop at the same edge router, which has learned a more specific discard route for the partner prefix. The endpoint responds from an independent connection and other destinations remain reachable.

Large transfers across the site-to-site tunnel stall while small requests succeed. Packet captures show large packets marked do-not-fragment being dropped at the tunnel boundary, with required ICMP replies blocked. The same transfer completes on a local subnet without crossing the tunnel.

A managed laptop repeatedly loses its camera in every video application. Device Manager reports a USB controller driver error; the built-in camera returns when the machine starts with the previous approved driver. The same synthetic account can use a camera on a spare laptop.

A workstation cannot install any approved desktop software. Its local Windows Installer service fails to start with a damaged service registration error, including when running a cached offline installer. Other workstations install the identical package successfully.

A single laptop restarts with a stop error whenever it resumes from sleep. The local crash dump identifies the recently installed storage driver, and rollback on that laptop stops the crashes. The symptom occurs before opening applications and with multiple test accounts.

A recurring room reservation moved by its organizer still appears at its old time in the room mailbox for every delegate. Exchange calendar diagnostics show a corrupted recurrence item; unrelated reservations update normally and the behavior is identical in web and desktop calendars.

A SharePoint library rejects spreadsheets whose names contain a newly prohibited pattern. Every member can upload the same content under a permitted name, and site storage is available. The library's tenant-managed file restriction policy lists the rejected pattern.

Messages to a synthetic distribution list are delivered twice to each recipient, from both web and desktop mail clients. Exchange message tracing shows a mail flow rule redirecting a copy back to the same list through a second address. Messages sent directly to recipients arrive once.

The billing application computes tax on the pre-discount amount for one synthetic discount code. The stored invoice lines are correct, but the server-side calculation trace applies the discount after tax. Different users and browsers reproduce the same incorrect total without connectivity errors.

An order system accepts a cancellation but still reserves the cancelled quantity. The application audit log records the status transition without the expected reservation release event. The problem reproduces only for orders split across two synthetic warehouses; stock infrastructure checks are healthy.

An HR application rejects a valid overnight shift because its end time is earlier than its start time on the clock. Daytime shifts save successfully. The server validation trace compares only times without considering the following date, and multiple accounts reproduce the rejection.

The remote desktop stopped opening this morning. The user reports a connection error but has not provided the exact message, whether authentication completed, or whether another device or location works.

A new project participant cannot edit documents in a shared site. It is not known whether other members can edit, whether the participant has the required access membership, or whether the site has been locked.

Calls in the meeting application become silent after a few minutes. No one has checked whether the microphone still works locally, whether other participants are affected, or whether changing network connections helps.

An internal web tool displays access denied after the user clicks a saved link. The report does not identify the page issuing the denial, the sign-in result, or whether other accounts can open the tool.

The sales portal takes a long time to save an order and sometimes times out. There are no timing traces or server logs, and the reporter has not tested another location or checked whether other application pages are slow.

A shared mailbox appears to be missing messages sent yesterday. There is no message trace, delivery failure notice, or comparison with the web mailbox, and it is unknown whether colleagues see the same gap.

The VPN will not connect from a test laptop. The report contains no error message or connection logs and does not say whether the client launches, the credentials are accepted, or another account works.
A scheduled report export has stopped producing files. No job logs are attached, and it is unknown whether the report generation step fails or the completed file cannot be written to its destination.

A laboratory gas chromatograph fails its internal pressure calibration with all sample lines disconnected. The instrument's standalone controller reports a carrier-gas regulator fault during its hardware self-test; no workstation or hosted service participates in the calibration.

An industrial robot stops at its safety interlock test. Its standalone safety PLC records disagreement between two emergency-stop contact channels even with the robot isolated from the plant data network. Inspection of the physical safety circuit is required.

A synthetic z/OS batch workload terminates with an S0C7 data exception in a COBOL packed-decimal field. JES spool output identifies the failing instruction and input record; terminal access and mainframe job submission operate normally.

An offline FPGA prototype produces incorrect CRC values only after a particular HDL bitstream is loaded. A logic analyzer shows a one-clock timing violation in the custom hardware pipeline; the vendor reference bitstream passes the same test vectors.
